title: Slider
description: A range slider component supporting single and dual-thumb modes with marks, tooltips, and form integration.

value.description: Current value (number for single thumb, [number, number] for range).

onValueChange.description: (value: SliderValue) => void — Fires when the value changes.

onValueCommit.description: (value: SliderValue) => void — Fires when a drag interaction ends (commit).

tooltipAlways.description: Always show tooltip, not just on hover/drag.

formatTooltip.description: (value: number) => string — Format the tooltip display value.

showMarkLabels.description: Show mark labels. Defaults to true when marks are provided.

renderThumb.description: (props: SliderThumbRenderProps) => ReactNode — Custom thumb content renderer.

renderMark.description: (props: SliderMarkRenderProps) => ReactNode — Custom mark dot renderer.

markDotSize.description: Size of mark dots in pixels.

transitionDuration.description: Duration in ms of the click-to-jump animation when the user clicks a mark or any point on the track. Set to 0 to disable. The animation is automatically suppressed during an active drag so the thumb tracks the cursor 1:1.

label.description: React.ReactNode — Label displayed above the slider.

error.description: Whether the slider is in an error state.

errorMessage.description: React.ReactNode — Error message displayed below the slider.

success.description: Whether the slider is in a success state.

successMessage.description: React.ReactNode — Success message displayed below the slider.

loading.description: Whether the slider is in a loading state.

unstyled.description: When true, removes all default styling.

aria-labelledby.description: ID of the element that labels the slider.

aria-valuetext.description: Human-readable text alternative for the current value.
